notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken Dragon with mana value 6.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, returning the Dragon with mana value 6 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Bladewing.
When Bladewing dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.
